---
title: "Privacy"
---

Sjónabókarstafróf is a static website on GitHub Pages. It has no accounts, and text you type in
*Test the fonts* stays in your browser.

To see which pages are used, we would like to count visits with
[Google Analytics](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites), set up through Google
Tag Manager. It only starts after you
press **Accept** in the banner at the bottom of the page. Until then no request is sent to Google
and no analytics cookies are set. If you accept, Google Analytics sets the `_ga` cookies and records
the pages you open, your browser type and an approximate location (country or city). Google
Analytics 4 does not store IP addresses, and advertising features are switched off. Your choice is
kept in your own browser and also applies to the other HiDef Textiles sites on
hideftextiles.github.io. You can change it any time with
[Cookie settings](#analytics-settings) in the footer.

Questions about the data go to HiDef Textiles, Háskóli Íslands.
